event_chain.summary: Employee altered billing and patient payment records

summary: Hannah Richardson, an employee of the Brizius, Embry & Smith optometry office in Evansville, Indiana, used her system access from June 22 through July 2, 2026 to delete her own billing ledger (about $80) and alter more than 500 records of 52 patients, also using another employee's login to alter hundreds more. The changes deleted more than $25,000 in outstanding balances, about $7,600 in insurance adjustments and more than $47,000 in patient payments. The owners found the changes during routine review, traced them through login information and reported her to police; she was charged with theft, fraud and modifying computer data.
